summary.text: Tony Bisignano is a Democratic Iowa state senator who has served in the Iowa State Senate since 2015, currently representing District 15, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
His career includes work as the human resources director for Polk County, Iowa.

paragraphs.text: Tony Bisignano was born in Des Moines, Iowa, and graduated from Dowling Catholic High School.
His career experience includes working as the human resources director for Polk County, Iowa; he founded the Nick Bisignano Foundation and served as president of a local AFSCME union.
Bisignano won the Democratic primary for Iowa State Senate District 17 in 2014 and went on to win the general election, and he won re-election in District 17 in 2018 and in District 15 in 2022.

For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Senate Agriculture, Commerce, Judiciary, State Government and Ways and Means committees, the Rules and Administration Committee, the Fiscal Committee and the Legislative Council.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026, and is on the November 3 general election ballot.
